description: Answer a remark of a page's review (see get_wiki_page_reviews). As the page's author — whoever may edit it — 'fixed': true says it is put right in the version the page is at now, false that it still stands (it is then compared with this version, so the next edit asks again); 'note' says how. As its reviewer — or the project's lead — 'action': 'reopen' puts a remark said fixed back as standing, 'withdraw' takes it back. The reviewer is told of an author's answer.

fixed.description: The author's answer: true fixed, false still stands.

note.description: What was done, or why it stands.

name: answer_review_remark
title: Answer review remark
